text: 20-year-old male. The patient was previously healthy and has been brought to the emergency department due to agitation over the past 24 hours. speaker: Doctor
text: You are 20 with recent cocaine/ecstasy use and high-risk sexual behavior, plus jaundice and markedly elevated liver enzymes. Did you develop any fever, severe right-upper-quadrant pain, or notice any dark urine or pale stools recently?
